basis: G.25--G.28 prove a canonical smooth median tree for every locally free monoid, locally cyclic cut stabilizers, and unique global splittings of all affine stabilizer extensions over total open groups. The universal G route no longer requires an existence or stabilizer-extension theorem; its remaining gate is an equivariant interval/quotient resolution with these specified local groups.

A.31--A.33 settle rational exactness of the independently ordered binary-vector example by a finite exact-category averaging proof. The previously undecided rational profile is now proved; this example cannot refute A.3(iii), and strengthens the total counterexamples to A.3(vi)--(vii).
